# Vojislav Miloradovic - Machine-Readable Credentials Archive

> **Last Generated:** 2026-08-08 01:07 UTC
> Curated, structured, and token-optimized record of professional certifications, badges, and learning achievements across Microsoft Learn, AWS, Google Cloud, Credly, LinkedIn, and Google Developer.

- **Microsoft Learn**: 35,566 completed units | 4,798 total achievements | 5,984,250 XP
- **Google Cloud Skills**: 342 badges
- **AWS Skill Builder**: 520 completed courses/activities
- **Credly**: 519 credentials
- **LinkedIn**: 1,297 verified external certifications
- **Google Developer**: 171 milestone badges | 1,456 codelabs & activities
